text: Based on the evidence, the asset experienced deforestation events (tree-cover loss) in 2021 (81.3 ha, 2.23% of asset), 2022 (0.6 ha, 0.02%), and 2023 (4.5 ha, 0.12%) after the 2020 baseline. These events meet the corroboration rule (JRC 2020 data agrees on ≥50% of the event area). The total loss after the baseline is 86.4 ha, exceeding the EUDR’s 4% threshold for deforestation-free supply chains. Therefore, the asset is **not EUDR compliant** due to verified deforestation post-2020.
